00095 template <class XFadeTextureEventType, class OwnerType>
00096 class XFadeTextureEventUGenInternal : public XFadeTextureUGenInternal
00097 {
00098 public:
00099     XFadeTextureEventUGenInternal(const float sustainTime,
00100                                   const float transitionTime,
00101                                   const int numChannels, 
00102                                   const int maxRepeats,
00103                                   OwnerType* o) throw()
00104     :   XFadeTextureUGenInternal(sustainTime, transitionTime, numChannels, maxRepeats), 
00105         event_(o)
00106     { 
00107     }
00108     
00109     XFadeTextureEventUGenInternal(const float sustainTime,
00110                                   const float transitionTime,
00111                                   const int numChannels, 
00112                                   const int maxRepeats,
00113                                   XFadeTextureEventType const& e) throw()
00114     :   XFadeTextureUGenInternal(sustainTime, transitionTime, numChannels, maxRepeats), 
00115         event_(e)
00116     { 
00117     }
00118 
00119     UGen spawnEvent(SpawnUGenInternal& spawn, const int eventCount) throw()
00120     {
00121         UGen event = event_.spawnEvent(*this, eventCount);
00122         spawn.nextTime = transitionTime + sustainTime;
00123         Env env(Buffer(0.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0), 
00124                 Buffer(transitionTime, sustainTime, transitionTime), 
00125                 EnvCurve::Welch);
00126         return event * EnvGen::KR(env, UGen::DeleteWhenDone);
00127     }
00128 
00129 protected:
00130     XFadeTextureEventType event_;
00131 };

00237 class OverlapTextureUGenInternal : public SpawnUGenInternal
00238 {
00239 public:

00242                                const int density_,

00244                                const int maxRepeats)  throw()
00245     :   SpawnUGenInternal(numChannels, (2.f * transitionTime_ + sustainTime_) / density_, maxRepeats),

00252         ugen_assert((sustainTime+transitionTime) > 0.f);
00253         ugen_assert(density > 0);
00254     }

00258     int density;
00259     
00260 protected:
00261 };
